newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - DECEMBER 12.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE KERB BOND DEALS - DECEMBER 12.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw Stock Exchange was at 15.3 million zlotys on Thursday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 2,000 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on February 12, 1999 traded at 93.65 zlotys.
* 4,300 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 traded at 80.00 zlotys.
* 2,000 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 traded at 79.95 zlotys.
* 5,000 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2001 traded at 81.65 zlotys.
